authority_scope: Prospective expected-result and scoped-comparison authority for canonical semantic requirements; no applicability decision, observation rewrite, discrepancy adjudication, waiver, claim issuance, or production vector is created here.

circularity_guards.statement: An observation cannot be an expectation basis; promotion requires a separately independent oracle basis and an explicit reviewed event.
Consensus and majority statistics are descriptive only and cannot establish an expectation or conformance judgment.
A stimulus generator and any evaluator in its semantic authority domain cannot supply the expected answer.
Missing documentation or standardization cannot imply rejection or unsupported behavior.
Conflicting legitimate claims remain separate and require an explicit unresolved conflict record.
Dependency traversal rejects indirect observation or target-output paths hidden behind claims or projections.
A designated profile is limited to declared intra-family comparison scope.
A campaign binds exact immutable oracle and expectation revisions; later authority changes cannot mutate that binding.

dependency_contract.authority_domain_rule: Tools, modules, aliases, wrappers, and processes backed by the same semantic implementation must share one authority_domain_id.
dependency_contract.traversal_rule: Validate the complete directed dependency graph from every root, reject cycles, and propagate prohibited source kinds and authority-domain taint through every intermediate claim or projection.

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: Only the exact normative source, edition, anchor, claim revision, and satisfied applicability scope are authoritative.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: A versioned normative source directly establishes the scoped expected behavior.
oracle_classes.name: normative-source

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: The conclusion is limited to the recorded construction, assumptions, and domain; using a regex implementation as calculator is not formal independence.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: An independently checked mathematical or mechanical construction establishes a result within its declared model.
oracle_classes.name: formal-derivation

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: The conclusion is valid only for the pinned data version, algorithm, and semantic rules governing use of that data.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: An independently versioned authoritative dataset and deterministic algorithm establish a data-scoped result.
oracle_classes.name: data-derived

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: Violation of a valid necessary invariant may establish a discrepancy; satisfaction never proves full correctness.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: A necessary relation among executions of the same applicable profile establishes relational satisfaction or violation.
oracle_classes.name: metamorphic-relational

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: The reference is not independent correctness authority and cannot produce universal normative conformance.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: A designated profile supports an explicitly family-relative comparison.
oracle_classes.name: designated-intra-family-reference

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: Agreement is conformance only to the implementation's own documentation, never silently to an external normative source.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: Versioned implementation documentation establishes what that exact implementation claims to do.
oracle_classes.name: implementation-documentation

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: The result is an empirical historical fact and cannot bootstrap itself into normative truth.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: A preserved historical observation is itself the scoped object of study.
oracle_classes.name: historical-characterization

oracle_classes.conclusion_boundary: No conformance verdict or expected result is permitted.
oracle_classes.epistemic_function: No admissible correctness oracle exists, so only observation, differential description, or a research gap may be recorded.
oracle_classes.name: characterization-only

promotion_contract.independence_rule: Every independent basis is traversed and must establish the expectation without depending on the promoted observation, evaluated target output, consensus, or generator evaluator.

resolution_states.meaning: An admissible oracle establishes the scoped expectation or relation.
The oracle is legitimate but its declared scope or applicability condition is false.
The authority does not select one unambiguous expected result.
Applicable authority intentionally leaves the relevant behavior open.
Two or more legitimate authorities establish incompatible scoped expectations; every claim is preserved.
Required pinned source, data, construction, or reference inputs are unavailable.
No admissible correctness oracle exists; execution may produce characterization but no conformance verdict.

selection_and_conflict.compatible_composition_rule: Compatible claims may be jointly bound only through an explicit immutable projection naming every oracle revision.
selection_and_conflict.conflict_rule: Incompatible legitimate expectations remain separate and create conflicting-authoritative-expectations with no automatically selected winner.
selection_and_conflict.selection_rule: Evaluate each applicable oracle independently for its declared epistemic purpose. Never select an oracle merely from its O-number.
